scenario: the first practical exchange about workplace everyday communication
english_title: Recognising and Responding to the First Practical Exchange About Workplace Everyday Communication
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: workplace everyday communication — the first practical exchange about workplace everyday communication
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to the first practical exchange about workplace everyday communication; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Sarah asks Ms Lan if she is ready to finish work for the day.
context_note_vi: Chị Sarah hỏi chị Lan đã sẵn sàng kết thúc công việc trong ngày chưa.

turns.speaker: Ms Sarah
turns.english: Lan, are you ready to finish for today?
turns.vietnamese: Lan này, chị sẵn sàng nghỉ hôm nay chưa?

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Yes, I am ready to go home.
turns.vietnamese: Vâng, tôi sẵn sàng về nhà rồi.

turns.speaker: Ms Sarah
turns.vietnamese: Tốt quá. Hẹn gặp lại ngày mai.
